name: Tenshi Kikou Shikkoubu Tamashii Kyuusai-ka
original_name: 天使機構執行部魂救済課
source:
Supernatural phenomena beyond human comprehension, seemingly the work of spirits.

As these incidents rapidly increased, they came to be known as "Ghosturbance Cases" and became part of everyday life.

The "Angelic Agency," an organization investigating these cases, assigns its officer, Tsujitsuma, to a murder investigation.

While Tsujitsuma approaches the case as part of his duties, the story takes an unexpected turn.

The key to unraveling all these incidents lies in—"memories."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3370180/Angelic_Agency_Soul_Salvation_Unit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
超出人类理解范围的超自然现象，似乎是鬼魂的杰作。

随着这些事件迅速增加，它们被称为“鬼事件”，并成为日常生活的一部分。

调查这些案件的组织“天使机构”指派其官员辻妻参与谋杀案调查。

当辻间将案件作为其职责的一部分处理时，故事发生了意想不到的转折。

解开这一切事件的关键在于——“记忆”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3370180/Angelic_Agency_Soul_Salvation_Unit/]Steam[/url]]
